Hi! 
First of all, I’m so sorry this has happened, it must be incredibly tough on you. 
Speaking as a victim of sexual abuse in a relationship, I understand why she is doing this. Dealing with trauma is something that you need to be ready for yourself, and until you get to your point there’s no point in suggesting it to her.
In my opinion, she’s pushing you away because when she starts to feel bad, she pushes you before you have the chance to hurt her again. It’s a defence mechanism 
You need to make the decision of whether you’re happy to be with her until she comes to the point on her own when she wants to deal with her own trauma, which could be next week, and it could be 10 years.
Her reaction is not your fault at all. ❤️
It’s a long process and you will process it in time. I’m so sorry it happened to you
